title: BPW-2026-0487
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0487
CD 7
TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) NO. 25-003 – SYLMAR FIRE STATION NO. 31
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue the task to Carrier Johnson + Culture, from the Pre-Qualified On-Call Architectural and Related Professional Services Consultants List to provide professional design and construction administration services for Sylmar Fire Station No. 31, as stated in TOS No. 25-003, with a budget authority of $1,762,552, including contingency.
(W.O.: E1908859, C-202130)
summary: Authorization to issue task for professional design and construction services for sylmar fire station No. 31.

locations.text: SYLMAR FIRE STATION No. 31, Los Angeles, CA
